classes/ebonmar-infiltrator-261.name: Piercing Insight
classes/ebonmar-infiltrator-261.description: Gain a +1 bonus on Search, Sense Motive, and Spot checks at 1st level. The bonus increases to +2 at 4th level, +3 at 7th level, and +4 at 10th level.

classes/ebonmar-infiltrator-261.name: Speed Reader
classes/ebonmar-infiltrator-261.description: Read a single page of text as a full-round action, including text interpreted through comprehend languages or Decipher Script.

classes/ebonmar-infiltrator-261.name: Spells
classes/ebonmar-infiltrator-261.description: Cast arcane spells from the Ebonmar Infiltrator spell list using Intelligence. Bonus spells are based on Intelligence, save DC is 10 + spell level + Intelligence modifier, printed zeroes grant only bonus spells, and spells are prepared and cast as a wizard prepares and casts spells.

classes/ebonmar-infiltrator-261.name: Sneak Attack
classes/ebonmar-infiltrator-261.description: Gain +1d6 sneak attack damage at 2nd level, increasing to +2d6 at 5th level and +3d6 at 8th level. This extra damage stacks with sneak attack from other sources.

classes/ebonmar-infiltrator-261.name: Combat Anticipation
classes/ebonmar-infiltrator-261.description: While wearing light armor or no armor, gain +1 dodge AC, +1 Reflex, and +1 initiative at 3rd level; these bonuses improve to +2 at 6th level. The AC and Reflex bonuses apply only against humanoids, monstrous humanoids, and giants.

classes/ebonmar-infiltrator-261.name: Uncanny Dodge
classes/ebonmar-infiltrator-261.description: Retain your Dexterity bonus to Armor Class when flat-footed or struck by an invisible attacker unless immobilized; existing uncanny dodge follows the normal multiclass improvement interaction.

classes/ebonmar-infiltrator-261.name: Hide in Plain Sight
classes/ebonmar-infiltrator-261.description: At 8th level, use Hide in natural terrain even while being observed.

classes/ebonmar-infiltrator-261.name: Hyper-Awareness
classes/ebonmar-infiltrator-261.description: At 9th level gain darkvision out to 30 feet and blindsense out to 5 feet.

classes/ebonmar-infiltrator-261.name: Shadow in the Night
classes/ebonmar-infiltrator-261.description: Once per day as a spell-like ability, become ethereal for up to 1 round plus a number of additional rounds equal to your Intelligence modifier, otherwise functioning as ethereal jaunt.
